domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, approval/rejection, and optional cancellation. Serves as the central aggregate root for the leave management bounded context.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days employees are entitled to, whether accrual applies, minimum notice requirements, and whether manager approval is mandatory. Policies are organization-wide and apply to all eligible employees.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organization. Each employee has a manager (except top-level), belongs to a department, and holds leave balances. The employee's employment status governs whether they can submit leave requests.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, usage, and remaining balance for a specific leave policy within a fiscal year. Every employee has one balance per active policy per fiscal year. Balances are the source of truth for leave availability checks.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Catalog of leave type codes (annual, sick, emergency) used to classify leave requests and policies. Each LeavePolicy and LeaveRequest references a LeaveType for categorization and rule lookup.

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification sent to an employee or manager in response to leave-related events (submission, approval, rejection, cancellation). Ensures stakeholders are informed of state changes in the leave workflow.

domain_entities.name: AuditLog
domain_entities.purpose: Immutable record of every state-changing operation across the leave management module. Required by GP-002. Captures CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, and REJECT actions with before/after snapshots and attribution.

sql_schemas: table employees | fields: id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_number: unique lookup by employee number; email: unique lookup by email; manager_id: listing direct reports for manager approval workflows; department: filtering employees by department; employment_status: filtering active/inactive/terminated employees

table leave_policies | fields: id, policy_name, leave_type_id, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_types.id | indexes: leave_type_id: joining policy to leave type for entitlement lookups; is_active: filtering active policies for balance calculations; policy_name: unique lookup by policy name
